relations.name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
relations.rationale: The bright, zesty flavors of preserved lemon complement the smoky heat of harissa, creating a balance that enhances both dishes.

relations.name: Berbere
relations.rationale: Harissa and berbere both are spice blends that incorporate chili and earthy spices, making them suitable for use in similar dishes.

relations.name: Ras el Hanout
relations.rationale: Like harissa, ras el hanout is a North African spice mix that adds depth and complexity to various dishes, allowing for creative culinary overlap.

relations.name: Vegetable and Beef Skillet
relations.rationale: The rich flavor of the vegetable and beef skillet can be enhanced with the spice and heat of harissa, providing a harmonious flavor profile.
